evidence: The CBD CdS, was deposited on ﬂuorine doped tin oxide glass, using a bath of ammonium hydroxide solution with cadmium sulfate and thiourea stirred at 65 °C. The ALD CdS was grown at 140 °C using alternating pulses of dimethyl cadmium and 15% hydrogen sulﬁde/85% N2 in a Beneq TFS 200 ALD system.
